intro: You came in on Friday. You horsed around a little too hard.
There are no mirrors in here, so you didn't notice.
Somewhere out there is a stable. Ours. Let's trot home.

spirit_guide.first: First memory: your glasses, under a speaker. Try not to step on anyone's leather.
spirit_guide.fragment_1: Glasses. Wait, why do we have horse eyelashes? Press Q, check our front leg.
spirit_guide.fragment_2: 47. We paid 25 euros to become livestock. Find ticket 47 by the bar.
spirit_guide.fragment_3: Ticket 47. Next: hand it to coat check. Act natural.
spirit_guide.fragment_4: Your keys. No thumbs to hold them. Next: the riddle horse, in the toilets.
spirit_guide.fragment_5: That's the way out. Next: the back exit. Trot like you own the place.
spirit_guide.mate: Mate. Clearer. Shakier. Classic Berlin hydration.
spirit_guide.look_blurry: Everything is a smudge. We need our glasses first.
spirit_guide.stamp: A stamp. 47. We had a number.
spirit_guide.all: We remember. The street, the bike, the river. Go.
spirit_guide.herd_warning_1: That's once. The herd were people too, you know. They passed out three times.
spirit_guide.herd_warning_2: Twice. One more blackout and we legally belong to the Panorama Bar herd.

unicorn.blessing: The rare unicorn nods once. Your vision snaps razor sharp. You feel weirdly hydrated.

losses.passed_out: You wake up in the toilet queue. Someone is still talking about their ex.
losses.caught: Animal control drops you back where you were. He asks if you can get him in next time.

endings.full_memory: You wake up in your own bed. Human. There's a hoofprint on the pillow.
endings.partial_memory: Monday, noon. The club is closing. You're outside in the queue. Still a horse. Try again?
endings.secret_dj: You never left. You are the resident horse DJ now.
endings.herd: You stopped looking for the exit. Now you dance in perfect sync with the others. Forever, or at least until Monday.

title: ESCAPE BERGHAIN

lines: Sneak past security and escape before you forever fall into the horse hole.
Get out the back exit before you black out.

start.tagline: Out of the stable since Friday.

items.glasses_slip_1: It slips. Hooves are not hands.
items.mate_found: A bottle of MATE. Space to drink.

herd.hint: Stand in their line. E on the beat. Four times.
herd.miss: Off beat. They pretend not to notice.
herd.synced: The herd turns as one and stares at the bar.

gate.locked: A door to the stairs. Locked. The riddle horse might know something.

credits.heading: GARDEROBE
lines: Music: made live in your browser

caught.title: ANIMAL CONTROL
caught.sub: Van ride. Back to where you were.

dj.hint: The decks are right there. Stomp on the beat. Eight times.

door: The front door is never the way out.
selfie_after: They have a sticker over their camera now. Berghain rules.

finale.start: Closing time. House lights. Every torch in the building is looking for us. RUN.

talk_hint: Space to continue. Esc to leave.
